scientific_scope: One-at-a-time boundary analysis of the reconciled p4 proxy; these runs supplement and do not replace the archived main comparison.

equation_contract.survivability: min(1, 0.42 * (1 - outage_severity) + survivability_action_scale * sum_i g_i x_i / 24)
equation_contract.inactive_configured_coordinate: DER-output multiplier; it remains generated but does not enter any p4 objective
equation_contract.repair_boundary: The repair score remains fixed, including g_i/2; survivability_action_scale changes only the displayed survivability equation.

scenario_protocol.scenario_count_rule: Search and evaluation use the declared count; screen_k is one quarter of that count.

optimizer_protocol.comparison_samples: Method-specific seed hashes create independent, not paired, optimizer samples.

hypervolume_protocol.bounds: For each setting, one method-independent evaluation reference sample: empty plan, every singleton, and 2048 seeded random budget-feasible plans; 5% span margin.
hypervolume_protocol.front: Budget-feasible unique plans, non-dominated in raw mean-objective space.
hypervolume_protocol.primary: Affine normalization, componentwise clipping to [0,1], exact hypervolume at reference point (1.1,...,1.1).
hypervolume_protocol.clipping_audit: Recompute exact hypervolume from the same raw front without [0,1] clipping; points not dominated by the reference point cannot contribute.

analysis_protocol.primary_gap: SHIELD-MOEA minus NSGA-II+Repair mean hypervolume within each setting.
analysis_protocol.mechanism_gaps: SHIELD-MOEA minus each GA-only, DE-only, and fixed-worst-K control within each setting.
analysis_protocol.uncertainty: Pointwise, multiplicity-unadjusted 95% percentile bootstrap interval for the independent-sample mean difference; 5000 resamples with comparison-derived fixed seeds.
analysis_protocol.claim_boundary: Exploratory boundary evidence; no equivalence claim and no replacement of the main archive.
